findings.claim: The new context sheet open flag is persisted even though it is documented as transient, so a stored `true` value can reopen or flash the sheet on later sessions.
findings.evidence: The diff adds `contextSheetOpen` with the comment `/** Context panel as a sheet below 1280px; never persisted. */` and places it inside the Zustand `persist(...)` state without adding any `partialize` exclusion, so default persist behavior stores it with the rest of the state.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a `partialize` option to the `persist` config that excludes `contextSheetOpen` (and other transient sheet/drawer flags such as `mobileSidebarOpen` if they must not survive sessions).
